hints.title: Monotonic Feasibility Range
hints.text: If a maximum limit M is sufficient to form both arrays, any value greater than M is also sufficient.

hints.title: Multiples and Least Common Multiple
hints.text: Numbers divisible by divisor1 cannot be placed in the first array, and numbers divisible by divisor2 cannot be placed in the second array.

hints.title: Inclusion-Exclusion Counting
hints.text: Numbers divisible by lcm(divisor1, divisor2) cannot be placed in either array. Verify that individual and pooled capacity requirements are satisfied.

hints.title: Binary Search on Answer Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import math

class Solution:
    def minimizeSet(self, divisor1: int, divisor2: int, uniqueCnt1: int, uniqueCnt2: int) -> int:
        lcm = (divisor1 * divisor2) // math.gcd(divisor1, divisor2)
        lo = 1
        hi = 10**10
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            c1 = mid - mid // divisor1
            c2 = mid - mid // divisor2
            cb = mid - mid // lcm
            if c1 >= uniqueCnt1 and c2 >= uniqueCnt2 and cb >= uniqueCnt1 + uniqueCnt2:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid + 1
        return lo
```

complexity.notes: Binary search on monotonic answer bound with constant time arithmetic checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy generation of arrays element-by-element takes linear time in output value up to 10^10.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulates the inclusion-exclusion counting constraints and applies binary search over the answer domain.
